svg.title: DNA double helix, schematic
svg.desc: Left: two antiparallel strands, 5' to 3' on top and 3' to 5' below, joined by complementary base pairs: A-T with two hydrogen bonds, G-C with three. Right: a right-handed double helix with alternating major and minor grooves, 3.4 angstrom rise per base pair, about 10 base pairs per turn and about 20 angstrom diameter.
svg.text: DNA: two antiparallel strands held by complementary base pairs
dashes = hydrogen bonds: A-T has 2, G-C has 3

text.font-family: Menlo, Consolas, DejaVu Sans Mono, monospace
Menlo, Consolas, DejaVu Sans Mono, monospace

svg.text: strand 2 read 5' to 3' = reverse complement: CGACT
Right-handed; ~10 bp/turn in the 1953 model, ~10.4 in solution.
